_comment: Manual entries for models the automated source (models.dev) misses or gets wrong. Entries here are the human-maintained source of truth for these models: the fetch script never touches models with source "manual" in data/models.json, and it never re-dates anything without --allow-redate. When you add a model here, also add it to data/models.json with source "manual" (or wait for the next fetch run to report it as a candidate and add it then).

known_date_disagreements.GPT-6 Astra: models.dev says 2026-09-04; stored date is 2026-09-03 from OpenAI's changelog. One day apart, unresolved — stored date wins.
known_date_disagreements.Mistral Medium 3.5 / Small 4: Stored dates are month-level (2026-04 / 2026-03, marked approximate). models.dev has exact dates (2026-04-29 / 2026-03-16). The fetch script reports these as refinements; applying them needs --allow-redate.
known_date_disagreements.Sonnet 4.6: models.dev says 2026-02-17; Anthropic's own announcement is dated 2026-11-08 and stored date is 2026-11-08. models.dev is wrong here — do not re-date.

why_manual.Cyber (OpenAI): Not in models.dev's openai provider — it was gated to the Daybreak Red program at launch. Date from OpenAI's changelog (Nov 5, 2026).
why_manual.Gemini 3 Pro: models.dev lists gemini-3-pro-image (Nano Banana Pro) but not the plain Gemini 3 Pro text model. Date from Google's announcement (Nov 18, 2025).
why_manual.Meta Llama 4 Scout / Llama 4 Maverick: models.dev's meta provider lists only the Muse family; the open-weight Llama 4 models are not in its catalog. Dates from Meta's Llama release notes (Apr 5, 2025).
why_manual.Muse Glimmer: Not in models.dev's meta provider. Date from Meta's announcement (Aug 10, 2026).
why_manual.Muse Spark Open: Not in models.dev's meta provider. Date from Meta's announcement (Oct 15, 2026).
